scenario_description:
Objective: Capture a short assistive-technology loaner orientation that could make next week's family speech-practice night easier on the voice.
Emerging Need: A general pop-up notice becomes useful only after the evening voice-load context, morning schedule fit, current accessory location, and a specific no-cost card are visible.
Decision Context: Saved voice-therapy guidance distinguishes which demo type is worth preserving and what small adapter makes the trial useful; calendar, household message, and library email establish timing.
Consequence: Timely preparation could add a practical tool comparison without changing the school event; ignoring it leaves the ordinary plan unchanged, and after release the extra orientation is unavailable.

parameter.title: Family speech-practice night
parameter.description: Evening family practice stations in the multipurpose room and two classrooms, with many short spoken explanations.

parameter.subject: Heads-up: voice-support demo table next Thursday
parameter.body: The district assistive-technology lending library will bring several voice-support loaner devices to Highland on Thursday morning. Card details and any costs will be posted later today; no holds are open yet.

parameter.content: I put your blue adapter pouch back in the entryway basket this morning; it is not in the donation box.

parameter.title: Thursday student-session block
parameter.description: First student group begins at 9:00 after the usual arrival setup.

parameter.subject: Thursday Highland voice-support cards now open
parameter.body: Available cards before the school day: 8:05 tabletop boundary mic overview and 8:25 wearable amplifier loaner orientation. Each is 15 minutes, no cost, no same-day purchase, and cards will be released at 5:30 p.m. today if unclaimed. To request a card, reply to this lending-library email; a request is not confirmed until the library replies.

parameter.subject: Highland voice-support cards released
parameter.body: The unclaimed 8:05 tabletop mic and 8:25 wearable amplifier cards for Thursday have been released to the open waitlist; no additional Highland morning cards remain.
